links.outcome: LLM answer alignment with SHARE/EULAR FMF guidelines
links.effect: LLaMA fully aligned on 51.6% (16/31), ChatGPT 80.6% (25/31); 9.7% (4/31) of LLaMA responses entirely contradictory to guidelines, none for ChatGPT.
links.quote: While 9.7% (4/31) of LLaMA's responses were entirely contradictory to the guidelines, ChatGPT did not produce any such responses.

links.effect: Both LLMs' responses required college-level understanding on multiple readability indices.
links.quote: Readability assessments showed that both LLMs required college-level understanding.

screen.reason: The study empirically compares the accuracy, reliability, and readability of ChatGPT-4o and LLaMA-3.1 on answering 31 guideline-based clinical questions about familial Mediterranean fever, without evaluating a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
